criteria.name: visual_completeness
criteria.description: appearance provides everything a portrait generator needs — age, build, hair, eyes, at least one distinctive feature, clothing style — and each detail is concrete enough to render. Vague inventory scores low even if complete. Test: does appearance have age, build, hair, eyes, a distinguishing feature, and clothing? If any are missing or described with placeholders ('medium height', 'dark hair', 'casual clothes'), score 0–40. Concrete on all fields scores 65+.

criteria.name: character_revealing
criteria.description: at least one visual detail reveals something about who this person is, not just what they look like. Ink-stained fingers, a too-careful posture, clothes that used to fit better — these imply history or habit. Pure inventory (hair color, height) is necessary but not sufficient. Test: is every appearance detail interchangeable with any other person in this genre, or does at least one detail make this person specifically visible? Pure inventory scores 0–35. One character-revealing detail scores 60+.
